items.q: I didn't seem to have that resistance, that bottom that singers usually have. And then after I got involved with those things like "Loch Loman" and "Molly and "If I Had A Ribbon Bow" Malone"

ctx.x: What were some of the other elements of your style since, you know, since you're talking about style now? You mentioned to me before that you had to develop a microphone style because you didn't naturally have a very robust voice.

Well, because I didn't have a robust voice, my voice was natural for a microphone with the amplification. And I didn't have to develop a microphone voice. I don't know if I'm allowed to describe what my voice was like in those days. It was mostly breathe. I didn't seem to have that resistance, that bottom that singers usually have.
